services.desc: Kimball Art Center collaborates with area schools to offer a creative space for kids at the end of the school day. Art After School is an after-school program that takes place at Park City elementary schools. It is designed for students in 1st through 5th grades and includes lessons in drawing, painting, sculpture, mixed media, and more. Expand their artistic horizons with art clubs and courses at the Kimball Art Center.
